exposure: modality of initial GDM management visit (virtual or in-person)
outcome: prescription of both insulin and metformin
cohort: Individuals with gestational diabetes attending interdisciplinary diabetes in pregnancy clinics in Calgary, Alberta, between 2017 and 2022.
finding: Virtual care for GDM management was associated with lower odds of large-for-gestational-age infants and cesarean section, lower odds of missing appointments, and greater odds of being prescribed both insulin and metformin.
mod_finding: Virtual care was associated with lower odds of cesarean section, with no significant differences found in rates of operative vaginal birth or induction of labour.
birth_weight: Large for gestational age (LGA), Small for gestational age (SGA)
gest_age: Used for classification of infant size (LGA/SGA)
